dublin_core_group.title: 2022 Miami-Dade CDC Social Vulnerability Index (tracts)
dublin_core_group.description:
Social vulnerability refers to the potential negative effects on communities caused by external stresses on human health. Such stresses include natural or human-caused disasters, or disease outbreaks. Reducing social vulnerability can decrease both human suffering and economic loss.

The CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index (CDC/ATSDR SVI) uses 16 U.S. census variables to help local officials identify communities that may need support before, during, or after disasters.

iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_2022_svi_tract/download -p /data/mdc_2022_svi_tract/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_2022_svi_tract
cd /data/mdc_2022_svi_tract

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# Create copy of geom dependency
pg_dump -d gaiacore -U postgres -p 5432 -h gaia-db -t fl_2022_svi_tract | sed 's/fl_2022_svi_tract/mdc_2022_svi_tract/g' | psql -d gaiacore -U postgres -p 5432 -h gaia-db 

# drop geom_local and subset as per custom parameters
psql -d gaiacore -U postgres -p 5432 -h gaia-db -c "
ALTER TABLE mdc_2022_svi_tract DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local;
DELETE FROM mdc_2022_svi_tract
  WHERE NOT (stcnty = '12086');
COMMIT;"
# add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
ALTER TABLE mdc_2022_svi_tract DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
  'mdc_2022_svi_tract',
  'geom_local', 2236, 'multipolygon', 2
);
UPDATE mdc_2022_svi_tract
  SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),2236)));
CREATE INDEX mdc_2022_svi_tract_geom_local_idx
  ON mdc_2022_svi_tract
  USING GIST (geom_local);
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
# add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
ALTER TABLE mdc_2022_svi_tract DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
  'mdc_2022_svi_tract',
  'geom_local', 2236, 'multipolygon', 2
);
UPDATE mdc_2022_svi_tract
  SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),2236)));
CREATE INDEX mdc_2022_svi_tract_geom_local_idx
  ON mdc_2022_svi_tract
  USING GIST (geom_local);
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
# Move into corrrect directory and create derivative directory in data package on osgeo
cd /data/mdc_2022_svi_tract/
mkdir -p derived

# Create shapefile of table in derivate directory on osgeo 
ogr2ogr -f "ESRI Shapefile" -overwrite derived/mdc_2022_svi_tract.shp PG:"<postgres connection>" mdc_2022_svi_tract

# Create downloadable tarfile of shp in derivative directory on osgeo
rm -f derived/mdc_2022_svi_tract.shp.tar.gz
tar -czf derived/mdc_2022_svi_tract.shp.tar.gz meta_dcat_mdc_2022_svi_tract.json -C derived mdc_2022_svi_tract.shp mdc_2022_svi_tract.prj mdc_2022_svi_tract.shx mdc_2022_svi_tract.dbf

# Move into correct directory
cd /data/mdc_2022_svi_tract/
